title: Bram and the Landfall
author: C. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Mirabel Iversen, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
